authority: Maryland 2025 Grades 6–8 crosswalks and companion guides
scope: Five suspected gaps in MD Grades 6–7; trace canonical family, generator, explanation/hints, and assessment tests

findings.generator_evidence: Counts values in one half-open histogram interval; returns two hints and misconception distractor
findings.explanations: Inline deterministic hints for bin inclusion; no verified complete histogram lesson
findings.assessment: Generator answer/distractor exists; no independently verified end-to-end mastery assessment for histogram shape/construction
missing_or_insufficient: construct/interpret box plot (no dedicated family found in inspected canonical domains)

findings.generator_evidence: Generates sorted eight-value data, calculates quartiles and IQR
findings.explanations: Inline hints for quartile halves and IQR = Q3 - Q1
findings.assessment: tests/test_canonical_depth_wave2.py has independent numerical quartile oracle for 20 seeds; no independent Maryland 6.DS.B.5 coverage or student mastery validation
missing_or_insufficient: interpret IQR in context and compare spread across distributions
connect five-number summary to actual box plot and distribution shape

findings.generator_evidence: Cube net question asks six-face area; existing rectangular-prism surface area family in app/domains/geometry_measurement.py
findings.explanations: Two deterministic cube-face-area hints and an edge-total misconception distractor
findings.assessment: Generated numeric answer available; no independently verified net-folding/shape-identification mastery test
missing_or_insufficient: identify valid versus invalid cube/prism nets
link net face layout to surface area and spatial visualization

findings.generator_evidence: Rectangular prism generator samples three integer dimensions via rng.randint(2,9)
findings.explanations: Inline hints multiply length width height; dimension-omission distractor; basic volume model metadata
findings.assessment: Deterministic integer volume question/answer exists; fractional-edge independent assessment not verified
missing_or_insufficient: unit-cube packing or fractional partition models
fractional multiplication reasoning and contextual units

findings.generator_evidence: Dedicated deterministic percent application generators with Decimal money arithmetic; ERROR.BASE analyzes incorrect base in percent change
findings.explanations: Inline hints and misconception distractors; scripts/seed_learn_content.py includes worked discount and tax examples
findings.assessment: Deterministic canonical answers available; no independent assessment covering all 7.AT.A.4 subcontexts confirmed
missing_or_insufficient: commission-based pay and fees (no dedicated family in inspected percent domain)
percent error versus measured/reference value (distinct from wrong-base error analysis)
multi-context coverage proof for current Maryland expectation
